scope.proposedCommitFiles: All regular files and symlink entries recursively under tests/p2-safety, including this scanner and existing reports/evidence.
scope.trackedProductionText: Tracked repository text files outside tests/p2-safety; content signatures only, filenames not treated as proposed commit files.
scope.skippedContent: Binary, non-text-extension, or files above 4194304 bytes are not content-scanned; filename rules still run for proposed files.
scope.limitations: Detects the listed credential and private-key patterns; does not guarantee detection of every secret encoding or credential form.
